sentence: This project studies how a warming climate and changes such as wildfire and permafrost thaw affect the Alaskan boreal forest.
This project builds mathematical and statistical tools that show when pooled sequencing data can tell closely related bacterial strains apart.
This project studies how tiny particles released by stem cells and macrophages work together to help blood vessels form.
This project builds computer models that predict how chromosomes fold in 3D and how genomic rearrangements change that folding.
This project builds a method to predict cold collisions of polyatomic molecules in an electric field and a quantum algorithm for chemical dynamics.
This project studies how much noisy quantum experiments can compute and builds quantum algorithms that beat classical computations.
This project combines automated experiments with machine learning to find which materials and processing conditions make better printed metal oxide semiconductor devices.
This project plans a center that uses AI on data from sensors and cameras to improve manufacturing.
This project studies how the ion channel that lets neurons sense touch is controlled in ducks that differ in their sense of touch.
This project studies how a community of soil bacteria breaks down polyethylene terephthalate plastic waste.
This project builds a program to teach secure mobile programming with a focus on cybersecurity.
This project builds computer simulations and automatic tuning methods that set up silicon quantum dot devices for quantum computing.
This project tests whether microbes in soil can adapt to more hydrogen and take up hydrogen leaked from the hydrogen energy sector.
This project studies what helps people stay in and finish degrees in computer science and information technology.
This project builds a way to make decisions in systems with many users, given uncertainty and how much the users trust the system.
This project studies whether mats of Rhizosolenia diatoms get their nitrogen from microbes that fix nitrogen gas.
This project studies how controlling power across a metal part in powder bed fusion sets its thermal history, porosity and microstructure.
